answer: Submissions that land within 147 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The vertex detector writes to terrace, and mirror reveals every merge. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, and as a result the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 289 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 21 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
